Raphaël Glucksmann Wins French Centre-Left Presidential Ticket

Raphaël Glucksmann has won the primary to represent the French centre-left in the upcoming presidential election. He secured 66.13% of the vote in the first round of the primary, which was organized by the Socialists and their centre-left allies. Glucksmann is the founder of Place Publique.
